items.title: A scheme colimit is also the colimit of algebraic spaces under four hypotheses

items.difficulty_reason: For a test algebraic space Z and a compatible family f_i, pull the etale cover W -> Z back to U_i -> X_i (object of lim X_{i,etale} with separated U_i -> X_i), realize U via hypothesis (4) and h : U -> W via (3); then (h,h) factors through W x_Z W because it does after composing with U_i x U_i -> U x_X U and U x_X U is the scheme-colimit of the pairwise products by (3); surjectivity of U -> X from (2) plus etale-sheafness of Z descends g to f : X -> Z.
